subject: storytime
title: Dragons Love Tacos words
about: Dragons will eat tacos by the bagful, so a boy throws them a taco party, but one jar of spicy salsa turns the whole thing into a fiery mess. This level teaches the words the child will meet in the book, so the library copy is easier to read on his own.
tip: After the level, borrow the book from the library and read it together, with him reading the taco words.

book.author: Adam Rubin
book.source: a library favorite; this level teaches its words, the app does not contain the book
book.blurb: A silly picture book about dragons, tacos and the one topping that dragons cannot handle.
